en.headline: Shein launches Hong Kong IPO aiming for up to US$27 billion valuation
en.dek: The fast-fashion retailer is offering 280 million shares at HK$47.60 to HK$49.50 each, with pricing set for 31 August and trading expected to begin on 1 September.
body: Online fast-fashion retailer Shein has launched book-building for its Hong Kong initial public offering, seeking to raise up to HK$13.86 billion and valuing the company at as much as about US$27 billion at the top of the indicated range.

According to the filing, the company is offering 280 million shares priced between HK$47.60 and HK$49.50 each. The final offer price is due to be announced on 31 August, with trading scheduled to start on 1 September. Cornerstone investors are expected to take a portion of the shares.
The valuation marks a sharp decline from the company’s earlier private-market peaks. Shein said proceeds would largely support technology improvements and efforts to expand its brand presence.

zh.headline: Shein啟動港股上市 最高估值約270億美元
zh.dek: 快時尚零售商今起招股，發售2.8億股，每股定價介乎47.6至49.5港元，預計8月31日定價，9月1日開始買賣。
body: 網上快時尚零售商Shein周一啟動香港首次公開招股，計劃集資最多約138.6億港元，按發售價上限計估值約270億美元。
根據文件，公司將發售2.8億股，每股定價介乎47.6港元至49.5港元。最終發售價預計於8月31日公布，股份則定於9月1日開始在港交所買賣。基石投資者將認購部分股份。
是次估值遠低於公司早前私募市場高峰。Shein表示，所得款項大部分將用於提升技術及加強品牌全球推廣。
